purpose: Remove redundant independent GPU initialization from native renderer tests while retaining parallel execution, and require bounded repeated real-adapter conformance on Linux CI.

contract.fixture: The three native GPU renderer tests reuse WgpuRuntime::shared instead of independently constructing devices. Keep renderer/buffer ownership, image/pick/transfer assertions and pure tests. Preserve the prior wasm test construction path. Production constructors, runtime ownership, device transfers and APIs do not change.
contract.concurrency: Add four synchronized native callers of the shared fixture. Verify one Arc runtime, distinct renderer identities and completed explicit uploads/recycling. No global test serialization, backend override or production locking.
contract.ci: Linux Visual conformance repeats the complete renderer unit binary in three separate four-thread processes. Require all four actual GPU completion markers; missing adapters and skipped GPU paths cannot pass repeated conformance. Stop on any failing process; no automatic retry or suppression. Keep fresh bounded logs and upload them on failure or success.
contract.evidence: Preserve the original PR 329 SIGSEGV and same-head retry. The exact crashing test, driver root cause and causal relationship to concurrent initialization remain unproven. Local WSL cannot mount its registered virtual disk; Linux acceptance is CI evidence, not a local Linux or physical hardware claim.
contract.preservation: Preserve scientific JSON, all frozen native binaries, previous camera outputs, resolved Cargo.lock and raw WASM. Cargo selects renderer library tests only, never rebuilds frozen examples, and runs locked/offline locally. No sensor/model/toolchain acquisition or changes to production Rust, core/GPU/math or dependencies.

resources.strategy: Reuse installed Rust and existing dependency artifacts. Write new logs/evidence on E:, permit at most 512MiB positive native-cache growth, retain all earlier evidence and failures. Repeated tests reuse the same built executable; no additional full workspace builds locally.

remaining_80_percent: Physical calibration/timing, independent motion, full-room accuracy, qualifying Linux hardware and integrated acceptance remain open.
